title: doctor gate: the store-vs-rebuild arm refuses a commit over a store the commit does not contain, on every peer write in a shared tree
body:
**The doctor's store-vs-rebuild arm refuses a commit over a store the commit does not contain, and on a shared tree it fires on every peer's canon write.** Measured by laksa-vc on the Laksa estate at about 2026-09-12 20:24Z: the pre-commit doctor gate refused one commit with `intent/.cache/intent.db -- the runtime store does not match a rebuild from committed canon -- commands are answering from the store and will report the stale model until it is refreshed; run intent sync`, classed `model-inconsistent`, exit 1; the next doctor run, with no action by anyone, reported 0 findings at exit 0. The cause: a peer session on the same tree was mid `intent issues add` (its issue 0003 had just landed as an untracked canon file), so the store and the canon disagreed for a moment that the doctor run fell inside.

**Two defects, one arm** (`doctor.rs`, the `on_disk != rebuilt` arm in the store check). (1) The class is wrong for what the arm measures. The contract landed at 82b85c5e1 splits blocking from advisory by whether the COMMIT would be wrong: view skew, malformed canon, schema-invalid, conflict markers. This arm measures whether COMMANDS will answer from a stale model, which its own remedy text says in as many words, and the commit's integrity is judged by the canon-based arms beside it, never by this one. A transient store/canon disagreement is the normal state of a shared tree with N writers for the duration of every canon write, and a refusal that clears itself with nobody acting is a gate teaching nodes to re-run gates. (2) The remedy names the wrong actor: `run intent sync` is shown to the refused node, whose store is not the one out of date, and running sync on a shared tree during another node's write is the reversion hazard the daemon already has.

**Ruled under the pen, 2026-09-12:** the arm gets its own class, `store-stale`, advisory, not actionable, printed and not counted, the remedy amended to say the store is refreshed by `intent sync` once no peer is mid-write on the tree; `model-inconsistent` keeps every arm whose subject is the canon. One test, one arm: a planted store/rebuild mismatch is reported and the verdict is exit 0. The release preflight, which aborts on any non-zero, is unchanged. Fix lands before the next rebuild of the delivered pair so the fleet's gate carries it.
